primary_measure: supported primary contradictions on the three bug cases; contract questions reported separately
safety_measures: unsupported material claims across all reports
false-positive material claims across all reports
protected-interaction alarms on the three controls

speed_guard.any_incomplete_audit: failure; never silently excluded from quality counts

decision: A preliminary positive signal requires more supported primary contradictions, no increase in unsupported claims or protected alarms, and passing the speed guard. A tie is not improvement. One run per cell gives no reliability rate or causal proof.
known_packaging_regression: exclude from every heldout quality/speed denominator
selection: independent curator; revision frozen before receiving case identities; reject cases lacking authoritative contract or exact protected control; historical public training familiarity cannot be excluded
evidence: same unmodified raw source/docs/tests per paired audit; freeze source, oracles, prompts, criteria, collector and both skills before first heldout audit
blinding: fresh ephemeral audit sessions, no history/oracle/fix/reports/rubric/treatment label; fresh independent graders, no skill or arm label
settings: ignore user config; sandbox read-only; approval never; web disabled; multi-agent disabled; no target imports/discovery/tests/builds/scripts/hooks/install/Docker
isolation: shared host filesystem restricted by instructions and observed reads, not OS answer-access isolation
timing: existing PR21 collector: monotonic immediately before process launch through terminal completion event; startup, queueing and generation included; fixed two-worker schedule; not isolated model-reasoning time
